body.name: One-target binary-star library
body.construction: For \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), choose \(z\in V\) and \(\mathcal A_z\subseteq\Pi^{E_0}_z\) with \(1\leq|\mathcal A_z|\leq2\), set \(A_z=\bigcup_{B\in\mathcal A_z}B\), \(B^{\star}=e_z\mathbf 1_{A_z}^{\mathsf T}\), and \[\Sigma^{\star}=(I_p+B^{\star})(I_p+B^{\star})^{\mathsf T}=I_p+e_z\mathbf 1_{A_z}^{\mathsf T}+\mathbf 1_{A_z}e_z^{\mathsf T}+|A_z|e_ze_z^{\mathsf T}.\] The set of all such covariances is \(\mathcal W_2(E_0)\).
